title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67 - I. Allegro con brio
performer: Fulda Symphonic Orchestra, Simon Schindler, conductor (Orangerie Fulda, 2002)
format: Ogg Vorbis, 44.1 kHz, stereo, about 160 kbps
license: EFF Open Audio License 1.0 (attribution and share-alike, like CC-BY-SA); the composition is public domain. Original source: http://www-plan.cs.colorado.edu/henkel/fso/index-en.html
notes: Complete first movement, including the exposition repeat.

excerpt.notes: Recapitulation and coda, uncut. It starts in the brief dip just before the first G of the motto (G-G-G-Eb, then F-F-F-D at 257.6 s), with a 60 ms fade-in over the reverb of the preceding chord; keeps the oboe cadenza and ends on the real ending. If the start sounds abrupt, the previous cut (--start 260.45 --fade-in-ms 1500) skips the motto and fades in. The exposition and the coda are in different keys, so no clean join between them exists.
excerpt.command: uv run --project tools/analysis ps-analysis crop songs/beethoven-fifth/source.ogg --start 255.36 --end 435.5 --fade-in-ms 60 --out public/audio/beethoven-fifth.flac
